# Under load, a column drag's lift clamps the header strip's scroll

## Context

On 2026-10-07, shard 3 of `e2e-engine` failed on #19441, a cssnano bump that the development build serving the e2e suite never loads. The failing check was `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs:99`, "pass 1: mid-drag after sliding left" (run 37588060671, job 112682768320). The re-run passed and the PR merged. The red reproduces on `dev` without that PR (neomjs/neo@b2db92c5b7) when the CPU is throttled.

## The Problem

Observed, in CI and locally:
- Mid-drag, the centre header toolbar's native `scrollLeft` is **0** while the grid's `--grid-scroll-left` holds **412px**. Every header covers the wrong cell: `Total` starts at x=371, over year-column cells that start at x=349.
- Rates:
  - CI: 1 red in the last 60 e2e runs.
  - Local `dev`, unthrottled: 0 of 10.
  - CDP CPU throttling ×6: 7 of 92, all at "mid-drag after sliding left".
  - A drag started with no settle after the scroll, unthrottled: 0 of 6, sentinel present.
- Product effect: dragging a column in a horizontally scrolled grid can make the headers jump to the start and sit over the wrong columns until the drop re-syncs them (#12938). It also turns unrelated PRs red.

## The Architectural Reality

- #12955 fixed a partial clamp: native 358 against 412, caused by absolutised items shrinking the toolbar's scroll extent. Its fix (PR #12961) is a 1px extent sentinel at the pre-drag content extent. `SortZone.onDragStart` injects it only when `dragStartScrollLeft > 0` (`src/draggable/grid/header/toolbar/SortZone.mjs`, the `neo-sortzone-extent-sentinel` block), and `processDragEnd` removes it.
- `dragStartScrollLeft` is the toolbar's worker-side `scrollLeft` config, which `ScrollManager` updates from scroll events. The drop re-sync also keys on `owner.scrollLeft > 0`.
- The clamped value varies (0, 133, 192, 223), where #12955's was one column width: a second path into the same symptom.

**What the instrument shows.** A throttled copy of the spec (CDP CPU ×6) recorded each failure's toolbar state and every native scroll of the centre toolbar after the baseline:

| Runs | Failed | Sentinel | `scrollWidth − clientWidth` | Native `scrollLeft` at the assert | Toolbar scroll events, lift → assert |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPU ×6 | 7 of 92 | present in every failure | 412 in every failure | 0, 133, 192, 223 | exactly one, at the lift: 221–271 ms after arming in pass 1, or at pass 2's lift |
| unthrottled | 0 of 16 | | | | |

When the assertion reads the toolbar, its extent is intact. Its element was scrolled once, at the lift, to a value below the grid's scroll truth. Nothing scrolls it back before the drop re-sync (#12938).

**Mechanism.** `SortZone.onDragStart` lifts the items in the base class's update (`super.onDragStart`), then pushes the sentinel in a second `owner.update()`. Under load the two can land in separate frames. A layout between them sees the lifted items without the sentinel, the extent shrinks, and the browser clamps the element's `scrollLeft` once. The sentinel then restores the extent, but not the clamped `scrollLeft`. #12961 closed the clamp for a lift whose two updates share a frame; one that straddles a frame still clamps.

## The Fix

Either option keeps the element on the scroll truth for the whole drag:

1. **Re-apply once the sentinel has landed (smallest).** After the sentinel update resolves, `DomAccess.scrollTo` the toolbar to `dragStartScrollLeft`: the lift-time twin of #12938's drop re-sync. #12961 rejected a lift-time re-apply because the extent kept shrinking. With the sentinel in place, it holds.
2. **No clamp window (cleaner).** Land the sentinel in the same update as the lift, e.g. read the pre-drag extent before `super.onDragStart` and push the sentinel first.

The instrument (a CPU-throttled copy of `HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs` with the scroll trace) is the falsifier for either.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Under CPU ×6, the throttled `HeaderCellRectSync` variant passes 72 of 72 on the fix head. On the base it fails at least once in 72 (observed 7 of 92). The PR carries both receipts.
- [ ] The scroll trace shows no native scroll of the centre toolbar between the lift and the drop that the grid's scroll truth does not share.
- [ ] `HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs`, the grid drag-and-drop e2e specs and the unit suite pass.

## Out of Scope

- Other e2e flakes, e.g. GraphScene's lost-context test (#19444, fixed by #19445).
- The sentinel's design against `expandOwnerOnDrag` (#12961's rationale stands).

The fix section names this instrument as its test. It lived in my session scratchpad, so I'm keeping it here: `HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs` under CDP CPU throttling, plus a trace of every native scroll of the centre header toolbar.

To run it, save it as `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ScratchThrottledRectSync.spec.mjs`, then:

```bash
SCRATCH_CPU_RATE=6 npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/ScratchThrottledRectSync.spec.mjs --repeat-each=20 --workers=1
```

On unfixed `dev` at ×6, expect about 7 reds in 92 runs, all at "pass 1: mid-drag after sliding left". The failure dump carries `scrollCtx`: sentinel present, extent 412, one toolbar scroll at the lift. A fix holds when the same batch stays green. Delete the file before committing.

<details><summary><code>ScratchThrottledRectSync.spec.mjs</code></summary>

```js
import { test, expect } from '../../fixtures.mjs';

// SCRATCH (untracked, deleted after use): HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs under CDP CPU throttling, to
// reproduce PR #19441's intermittent CI red on dev. Same gesture, same assertions.
const RATE = Number(process.env.SCRATCH_CPU_RATE || 4);

test.describe('SCRATCH throttled header↔cell rect sync', () => {
    test.setTimeout(180000);
    test.use({ viewport: { width: 1920, height: 1080 } });

    const readPairs = page => page.evaluate(() => {
        const body   = document.getElementById('neo-grid-body-1');
        const clip   = body.getBoundingClientRect();
        const inClip = r => r.width > 0 && r.right > clip.left + 1 && r.left < clip.right - 1;

        const toolbar = document.querySelectorAll('.neo-grid-header-toolbar')[1];
        const headers = [...toolbar.children]
            .map(b => ({b, r: b.getBoundingClientRect()}))
            .filter(({b, r}) => inClip(r) && getComputedStyle(b).visibility !== 'hidden')
            .map(({b, r}) => ({text: b.querySelector('.neo-button-text')?.textContent ?? b.id, x: Math.round(r.left), w: Math.round(r.width)}))
            .sort((a, b2) => a.x - b2.x);

        const row   = body.querySelector('[role="row"]');
        const cells = [...row.children]
            .map(c => ({c, r: c.getBoundingClientRect()}))
            .filter(({c, r}) => inClip(r) && getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none')
            .map(({c, r}) => ({id: c.id.split('__').pop(), x: Math.round(r.left), w: Math.round(r.width)}))
            .sort((a, b2) => a.x - b2.x);

        const scrollCtx = {
            trace            : (window.__tbScroll || []).slice(-12),
            anchor           : getComputedStyle(toolbar).overflowAnchor,
            sentinel         : !!toolbar.querySelector('.neo-sortzone-extent-sentinel'),
            scrollWidth      : toolbar.scrollWidth,
            clientWidth      : toolbar.clientWidth,
            toolbarScrollLeft: toolbar.scrollLeft,
            bodyScrollLeft   : body.scrollLeft,
            scrollVar        : getComputedStyle(body).getPropertyValue('--grid-scroll-left') ||
                               getComputedStyle(body.parentElement).getPropertyValue('--grid-scroll-left')
        };

        return {headers, cells, scrollCtx};
    });

    const assertAligned = ({headers, cells, scrollCtx}, label, midDrag = false) => {
        const dump = `scroll=${JSON.stringify(scrollCtx)} headers=${JSON.stringify(headers.slice(0, 4))} cells=${JSON.stringify(cells.slice(0, 4))}`;

        if (!midDrag) {
            expect(headers.length, `${label}: count parity — ${dump}`).toBe(cells.length);
        }

        headers.forEach(h => {
            const c = cells.find(cell => Math.abs(cell.x - h.x) <= 1);
            expect(c, `${label}: no cell under header "${h.text}" (x=${h.x}) — ${dump}`).toBeDefined();
            expect(Math.abs(h.w - c.w), `${label}: width mismatch for "${h.text}"`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
        });
    };

    test('throttled repeated back-and-forth drag keeps every header rect locked to its cell rect', async ({ page }) => {
        await page.goto('/examples/grid/lockedColumns/');
        await page.waitForSelector('[role="grid"]', { state: 'visible', timeout: 30000 });
        await page.waitForTimeout(600);

        const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
        await cdp.send('Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate', {rate: RATE});

        const gridBox = await page.locator('[role="grid"]').first().boundingBox();
        await page.mouse.move(gridBox.x + gridBox.width / 2, gridBox.y + gridBox.height / 2);
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            await page.mouse.wheel(800, 0);
            await page.waitForTimeout(120);
        }
        await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

        assertAligned(await readPairs(page), 'baseline (scrolled right)');

        // every native scroll of the centre header toolbar from here on: [ms since arm, scrollLeft]
        await page.evaluate(() => {
            const toolbar = document.querySelectorAll('.neo-grid-header-toolbar')[1],
                  t0      = performance.now();

            window.__tbScroll = [];
            toolbar.addEventListener('scroll', () => window.__tbScroll.push([Math.round(performance.now() - t0), Math.round(toolbar.scrollLeft)]))
        });

        const centerToolbar = page.locator('.neo-grid-header-toolbar').nth(1);

        for (let pass = 1; pass <= 2; pass++) {
            const src = centerToolbar.locator('.neo-draggable', { hasText: '2011' }).first();
            await expect(src).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
            const srcBox = await src.boundingBox();
            const y      = srcBox.y + srcBox.height / 2;

            await page.mouse.move(srcBox.x + srcBox.width / 2, y);
            await page.mouse.down();
            await page.mouse.move(srcBox.x + srcBox.width / 2 - 220, y, { steps: 50 });
            await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
            assertAligned(await readPairs(page), `pass ${pass}: mid-drag after sliding left`, true);

            await page.mouse.move(srcBox.x + srcBox.width / 2, y, { steps: 50 });
            await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
            assertAligned(await readPairs(page), `pass ${pass}: mid-drag after sliding back`, true);

            await page.mouse.up();
            await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
            assertAligned(await readPairs(page), `pass ${pass}: after drop`);
        }
    });
});
```
